name: Littleheads Kayak Rentals
description: Littleheads Kayak Rentals, established in 2013, is located in beautiful Perdido Key, Florida on a saltwater bay with uninhabited islands to paddle to and explore. Our waterfront location is situated on an inshore saltwater bay with tiny islands surrounded by giant sandbars between Ono Island with luxury houses and Holiday Marina, across from Lost Key Golf Course in Perdido Key, Florida. Kayaking is fun for everyone! Explore our area on your own with 3-hour kayak rentals or paddle board rental. Tandems and single kayaks available. Pictures taken upon request free of charge. Instruction provided for beginners. Whether you're a beginner or an expert you will love paddling here! There's a variety of marine life, nature scenery and islands to see and explore. We offer guided kayaking tours in a saltwater bay to several uninhabited islands with a marine life presentation, kayaking instruction, walking tours around the islands and plenty of paddling with beautiful views of boats and coastal birds. We accommodate large groups and pictures are included. We have 9 fishing kayaks available each with 2 rod holders and a lockable hatch. We are experts on fishing and will give you guidance on where to fish and what bait to use. There's a variety of saltwater species in our bay including Redfish, Speckled Trout, Flounder, Jack Crevalle, Mackerel, and Sheepshead. Our saltwater bay has a nursery pod of dolphins consisting of baby dolphins, mama dolphins, and godmother dolphins. Dolphins are seen every day! There are also redfish, speckled trout, manatees, sea turtles, hermit crabs and blue crabs, and coastal birds such as the Osprey, Great Blue Heron, Snowy White Egret, Snowy Plover, and Sandpipers.
